doc: Trust on the runtime plane. A runtime role reads (T0) or drafts (T1). Nothing above draft is ever held on this plane: a draft is accepted by a person or by the product's own check.

levels.name: read_only
levels.summary: Read what you were given, and change nothing.
may: read the brief, the facts, the sources and the rules you were given

levels.name: draft
levels.summary: Draft, record and propose; never accept.
may: record a fact with its source
propose a rule for a person to decide on
may_not: accept a draft, yours or another role's

levels.name: not_on_this_plane
levels.summary: Not held on the runtime plane.
may: nothing: no runtime role holds this level
may_not: held by no runtime role: the harness refuses a runtime role whose ceiling is above T1

escalation.doc: A role that needs something above its level stops, and escalates to a person with what it needs and why. It never asks another role to do it instead.
